note: Public identifiers for every model and fuser used in the paper. Model weights are not redistributed; obtain them from the Hugging Face Hub at the listed revisions.

c2c_runtime_source.use: not included; code/pipeline/native_action_runtime/legacy_methods.py imports it from the checkout named by the C2C_ROOT environment variable

runtime_settings: bfloat16 weights, SDPA attention, greedy decoding, thinking disabled, batch size 1, receiver max 64 new tokens, Text helper max 256 new tokens; see configs/*/frozen_config.json
software: Python 3.10.18, torch 2.6.0, transformers 4.52.4, tokenizers 0.21.4, numpy 2.2.6, scipy 1.15.3
hardware: one node with two NVIDIA A100 40GB GPUs (helper on one GPU, receiver and fuser on the other) for all complete end-to-end measurements
